comment: Golden vector for the combined {7,11} PolicyPCR policy digest (docs/Architecture.md §6.1.1). Formula (verified against live TPM trial sessions, tpm2-tools 5.8/swtpm): policy_digest = SHA256( zero32 || CC_PolicyPCR(0000017f) || TPML_PCR_SELECTION{count=1, sha256, sizeofSelect=3, select=80 08 00} || SHA256(d7_raw || d11_raw) ). The 4-byte command code IS part of the TPM2_PolicyUpdate hash (TPM 2.0 Part 3 PolicyContextUpdate); omitting it does NOT reproduce this vector.
